discoveredByPersona.description: V2: persona id that discovered this issue (PRD §10.5).

brainClaimIds.description: V2: brain claim IDs that support this issue.

driftSensitivity.description: V2: how sensitive this issue is to upstream drift.

councilConsensusLevel.description: V2: council consensus that surfaced the issue.

retestPackPath.description: V2: relative path to retest pack for verifying the fix.

triagedAs.description: Lifecycle metadata: when an issue is triaged as a duplicate, the triagedAs field captures the canonical issue id with the prefix 'duplicate_of='. Optional. Closes ISSUE-060.

closedAs.description: Lifecycle metadata: when an issue is closed, closedAs captures the closure verdict (e.g. 'fixed', 'wont_fix', 'duplicate', 'not_real', 'consolidated_into=ISSUE-NNNN', or a free-form short reason). Optional. Closes ISSUE-062.

closedOn.description: Lifecycle metadata: closure date in ISO-8601 form (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp). Set by sealing scripts when an issue moves to status:closed.

closedAt.description: Lifecycle metadata: closure timestamp in ISO-8601 form (legacy variant of closedOn used by Phase 47/48 sealing scripts). Optional.

closedBy.description: Lifecycle metadata: actor (agent identifier or phase tag) that closed the issue. Optional.

closedNote.description: Lifecycle metadata: free-form note attached to the closure event (e.g. 'fixed in 47-01 W1'). Optional.

closingPhase.description: Lifecycle metadata: phase number that closed the issue (e.g. '50', '51'). Pairs with closingPlan + closingCommit for full audit trail.

closingPlan.description: Lifecycle metadata: plan id within the closing phase (e.g. '50-02', '51-04').

closingCommit.description: Lifecycle metadata: short git commit hash that landed the fix (e.g. '9b2522d9').

closingNote.description: Lifecycle metadata: free-form note attached to closure (Phase 48 sealing variant). Optional.

closingNotes.description: Lifecycle metadata: free-form notes attached to closure (Phase 48b sealing variant). Optional.

closingReq.description: Lifecycle metadata: REQ-id that the closing phase mapped to this issue (e.g. 'REQ-50-147').

closedByCommits.description: Lifecycle metadata: array of short git commit hashes that contributed to the fix (when a single closure spans multiple commits across one plan).

closedInPhase.description: Lifecycle metadata: legacy variant of closingPhase used by early sealing scripts. Optional.

consolidatedInto.description: Lifecycle metadata: canonical issue id this issue was consolidated into (e.g. 'ISSUE-147'). Pairs with closedAs='consolidated_into=ISSUE-NNNN'.

statusHistory.description: Append-only audit log of status transitions. Each entry records ts, from, to, by, note. Distinct from the broader 'history' field which captures any kind of event.

by_phase.description: Lifecycle metadata: phase id that closed/retested the issue, in 'NN-WAVE' form (e.g. '47-W1'). Legacy variant used by Phase 47 retest-closure sweeps.

fix_commit.description: Lifecycle metadata: short git commit hash that landed the fix. Legacy variant of closingCommit used by Phase 47 retest-closure sweeps.
